name: 3D-aware Autoencoder
definition: An autoencoder trained to learn a 3D-consistent latent space by leveraging Tri-Plane representations to regularize the latent space with geometric constraints.
summary: A 3D-aware Autoencoder trains a VAE to produce a latent space preserving 3D geometric consistency by jointly optimizing the encoder, decoder, and a differentiable 3D scene representation like Tri-Planes.
